card.name: Handling and preparation instruction words
card.fires_on: A noun or verb inside practical how-to instructions in drug labels, such as preparing a vial, applying compresses, swallowing tablets, or spacing doses by days. It fires on the word that finishes a short handling phrase, like wall, hands, ice, or at.
